build_attention_module: build a Gemma Attention module with multi-head or GQA attention and RoPE positional embeddings
create_kv_cache: create a KV cache dictionary for Gemma transformer layers using Attention.init_cache
build_embedder_module: build a Gemma Embedder module to encode tokens or decode logits with optional vision projection
build_feedforward_module: build a Gemma FeedForward module with gated linear units and configurable einsum transpose
build_transformer_block: build a Gemma Block module combining attention, RMSNorm, and feed-forward with residual connections
